identityDecision: Create one canonical Noble Environmental, Inc. record and use Noble Environmental as its operating-name alias. Count the parent waste-management platform only. County Hauling, Westmoreland Sanitary Landfill, the named landfills and transfer stations, and the renewable-natural-gas facilities are subsidiaries or assets beneath Noble rather than separate Apollo portfolio companies. Noble Environmental Power is an unrelated legacy wind-energy company and is not an alias.
infrastructureScopeDecision: Include. Apollo's acquisition announcement describes Noble as a vertically integrated regional waste-management platform whose landfills, transfer stations and hauling operations are long-life hard assets providing essential services. Apollo's current Scott Browning biography identifies him as an Apollo Infrastructure Group partner and lists Noble among his current board roles.
censusCorrection: Confirm the census's CLOSED_ACTIVE majority ownership conclusion. Record the transaction as acquired by May 12, 2026, while leaving the exact legal closing date, percentage, specific fund and legal holding vehicle as not publicly disclosed.

ownershipDecision.currentEvidence: Apollo's current Scott Browning biography identifies Browning as a Partner in the Apollo Infrastructure Group and lists Noble Environmental among his current board roles. Noble's operating website remains live under the same brand.
ownershipDecision.exitSearch: No Apollo sale, transfer, divestiture, successor ownership transaction or signed pending sale involving Noble Environmental was identified through 2026-08-12.

companyDecision.operatingBoundary: Count Noble Environmental as the manager-level platform. Do not separately count its hauling businesses, landfills, transfer stations or renewable-natural-gas facilities.
